articles.title: Apple Unveils Its First Ever Foldable iPhone at Spectacular Autumn Event
articles.summary: Apple held its highly anticipated autumn launch event on 10 September 2026, revealing two exciting new products. The company's first foldable smartphone, called the iPhone Duo, features a large 7.6-inch display and is priced from HK$17,499 in Hong Kong. At the same event, Apple introduced the iPhone 18 Pro series, which for the first time includes an adjustable camera aperture, giving users much greater control over photography. New Apple CEO John Ternus led the presentation, describing the iPhone as a 'smart personal core' for daily life. Tech enthusiasts across Asia rushed to pre-order both devices online almost immediately after the announcements.

lv1: What is the name of Apple's brand-new foldable smartphone? (蘋果公司全新摺疊智能手機的名稱是什麼？)
What is one special new feature on the iPhone 18 Pro? (iPhone 18 Pro 有什麼特別的新功能？)
lv2: Why do you think Apple decided to make a foldable phone in 2026, and what advantages might it offer compared to regular smartphones? (你認為蘋果公司為何在2026年推出摺疊手機？與普通智能手機相比，它有什麼優點？)
How might a camera with a variable aperture change the way people take photos on their phones? (可變光圈相機如何改變人們用手機拍照的方式？)
lv3: Some people argue that frequent new smartphone releases encourage unnecessary spending and contribute to growing electronic waste problems. Do you agree? What responsibilities should technology companies have towards the environment? (有人認為頻繁推出新款智能手機助長了不必要的消費，並加劇電子廢物問題。你同意嗎？科技公司對環境應負有什麼責任？)

Should governments introduce laws to limit how often technology companies can release new devices, in order to reduce environmental harm? Discuss the possible benefits and drawbacks of such a policy. (政府是否應立法限制科技公司推出新裝置的頻率，以減少環境損害？試討論這類政策的利與弊。)

articles.title: Rare Visitor from Beyond Our Solar System Surprises Scientists with Unusual Chemistry
articles.summary: Scientists studying the interstellar comet called 3I/ATLAS have made a surprising discovery: this space traveller contains an exceptionally high amount of methanol, a simple type of alcohol. Researchers say this chemical signature indicates the comet was born in a region of the universe with very different conditions from those in our own solar system. The powerful ALMA radio telescope was used to detect tiny icy particles surrounding the comet. Because interstellar comets travel between star systems, they are extremely rare. Astronomers believe that studying 3I/ATLAS offers a unique chance to understand how the broader universe formed billions of years ago, far beyond our cosmic neighbourhood.

lv1: What unusual chemical was discovered inside the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS? (科學家在星際彗星3I/ATLAS中發現了什麼不尋常的化學物質？)
What is the name of the telescope scientists used to study this comet? (科學家用哪種望遠鏡研究這顆彗星？)
lv2: Why is it scientifically valuable to study comets that originate from outside our solar system? (研究來自太陽系以外的彗星，對科學有什麼重要價值？)
What does the unusually high level of methanol in comet 3I/ATLAS suggest about where it came from and how it formed? (彗星3I/ATLAS含有極高水平的甲醇，說明了它的來源和形成過程有什麼特別之處？)
lv3: Some scientists believe that studying interstellar objects could eventually help answer whether life exists elsewhere in the universe. Do you think this kind of research is worth the enormous cost and resources involved? Justify your view. (有科學家認為，研究星際天體最終可能有助回答宇宙中是否存在生命的問題。你認為這類研究值得花費巨大資源嗎？請解釋你的立場。)

If scientists were to discover that an interstellar comet carried the chemical building blocks of life, how do you think this finding would change humanity's understanding of our place in the universe? Would it matter to ordinary people? (假如科學家發現星際彗星攜帶了生命所需的化學物質，你認為這將如何改變人類對自身在宇宙中地位的理解？這對普通人有意義嗎？)

articles.title: 香港《施政報告》料推航天科技計劃　配合國家太空發展目標
articles.summary: 消息指出，香港2026年《施政報告》將宣布推出新一輪航天科技特別徵集，重點資助與國家航天任務相關的科研項目，同時探索發展商業航天保險市場的可能性。此舉配合國家「十五五」規劃中建設航天強國的目標，旨在把香港打造成為航天科技創新樞紐。業界人士認為，計劃有助吸引更多航天企業及科研人才落戶香港，推動本地創科產業多元化，進一步鞏固香港在粵港澳大灣區創科生態圈中的重要地位。

lv1: 香港《施政報告》計劃推出什麼新科技支援計劃？
這個計劃與國家哪個五年規劃有關係？
lv2: 你認為香港發展航天科技對本地學生和年輕人有什麼影響和機遇？
政府為何要在《施政報告》中特別支持航天科技發展，而不是其他行業？
lv3: 有人認為香港應集中資源鞏固傳統金融業優勢，而非投入大量資金發展航天科技。你同意哪種看法？請從不同角度加以分析。
香港在發展航天科技時，應如何平衡與內地的緊密合作和保持自身獨立的創新能力？兩者之間是否存在矛盾？

articles.title: 港府擬立法規管網約車服務　最快11月起向平台發牌
articles.summary: 香港政府宣布計劃透過立法正式規管網約車服務，預計最快於今年11月開始向相關平台發出牌照，並於第四季接受司機及車輛牌照申請。新規管制度旨在保障乘客安全，並為在港提供網約車服務的司機建立清晰的法律框架。法例將要求各平台符合保險、車輛及司機資格等標準。業界人士普遍對新制度持正面態度，認為有助提升行業整體專業水平，並增強市民對相關服務的信心。

lv1: 香港政府計劃對哪種交通服務實施新的法例規管？
政府預計最快在哪個月份開始向網約車平台發出牌照？
lv2: 政府為網約車服務立法，對乘客和司機分別有什麼好處？
如果沒有法例規管，網約車服務可能會帶來哪些安全或社會問題？
lv3: 有人認為政府規管網約車有助保障市民安全，但亦有人擔心監管過嚴會令車費上升、市場選擇減少。你認為政府應如何在保障安全與維持市場競爭之間取得平衡？
網約車的普及對傳統的士業界造成很大衝擊。在制定新規管政策時，政府應如何兼顧傳統的士司機、網約車司機及普通市民等不同持份者的利益？
